author: blu
body: To square gives the product of a number with itself. To cube gives a number raised to the third power. To math-abs gives the absolute value of an integer. To math-min gives the smaller of two integers. To math-max gives the larger of two integers. To math-clamp gives an integer constrained to the given lower and upper bounds. To math-mod gives the remainder after integer division. To math-isqrt gives the greatest integer whose square does not exceed the given number, and zero for anything below one.
